text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions. A core part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. A more advanced form is deep learning, which uses complex neural networks to handle tasks like image recognition. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. It powers voice assistants on our phones, recommends videos and products online, filters spam emails, and helps doctors analyze medical scans. While AI is not perfect, it continues to improve quickly, changing how we work, communicate, and live.
